One transition of the ecoregion-saturation state machine

Source: R/ecoregion_sampling.R
ecoregion_saturation_step.Rd

One transition of the ecoregion-saturation state machine

Usage

ecoregion_saturation_step(
  state,
  batch_keys,
  n_batch_points,
  min_points,
  patience
)

Arguments

state

A list with elements `n_points` (numeric), `seen` (character vector of grouping keys already observed) and `stale` (number of consecutive batches that brought no new key).

batch_keys

(character) Grouping keys (e.g. `ECO_NAME` values) of the new batch. `NA` and empty values are ignored.

n_batch_points

(numeric) Number of points in the new batch.

min_points

(numeric) Minimum number of points before the rule is allowed to fire.

patience

(numeric) Number of consecutive key-less batches tolerated before the set is declared saturated.

Value

The updated `state`, with a new logical element `saturated`.
